ops.name: title
ops.html:
D08B / Read me & build contract
Exposure, volatility and 3D investigation · Candidate R1 · RIG draft
Primary user: an options researcher testing a dated observation before continuing a research plan.

ops.name: notes-0
ops.html:
01 · Complete task
Underlying → dated exposure book → selected strike/expiry → exact contracts → comparison or volatility → original selection.
D08B owns GEX, Surface, Positioning, Levels, Volatility and 3D presentation. D08 owns navigation. D08C owns plans and saved scenarios. D08D owns replay data, cursor, entitlement and distribution.

ops.name: notes-1
ops.html:
02 · Read the candidate
B01–B03/B10–B11 matrix and phone; B04/B08 volatility; B05/B06 gamma 3D/2D; B07/B16 comparison; B13 chain; B14 levels; B15 states; B17 contracts; B09/B12 annotations.
All figures are a labeled illustrative fixture with explicit semantics. No measured usability, live model or production acceptance is claimed.

ops.name: notes-2
ops.html:
03 · Identity and numerical truth
A node is an aggregate until exact source contracts are resolved. Carry root, snapshot, coordinate, metric, unit, lens, qualification and source clocks.
Call+/put− is the declared fixture convention. Comparison is matched observation change, never order flow. Spot, OI position day, OI report date and availability are distinct.

ops.name: notes-3
ops.html:
04 · Responsive and access
Useful width = viewport − actual rail − two gutters. Dock320+24 only if primary≥640; otherwise use modal/full-screen details.
320/390: complete Views and Research pickers; selected expiry chart; exact values. Keyboard, touch and reduced-motion must reach the same node and operations.

ops.name: notes-4
ops.html:
05 · Source and review
Parent: macro #10649 · D08-OPTIONS/1.0.0 at d0516e1. Programme package 6e186286. Source package: research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/d08b/.
F01/F02 candidate.4 geometry is an input, not a released foundation. Reference acceptance requires independent product and taste findings and the existing RIG process.

ops.name: notes-5
ops.html:
06 · Builder acceptance
No cross-root stale result, null→zero conversion, substituted expiry, future-known comparison, false durable save or detached focus.
Preserve every existing analytical view. Lazy-mount3D, bound visible cells and requests, supply semantic exact values and source-limited exports. No product implementation or deployment in this commission.

name: B12 · Interaction and state annotations · R1

ops.name: title
ops.html:
D08B / Control and transition annotations
Read beside B01–B14 · implementation obligations, not runtime proof

ops.name: note-0
ops.html:
B01 · Matrix and inspector
Arrow keys move cell focus; Enter selects. Selection binds exact root, snapshot, ISO expiry, strike, lens, metric and unit.
Scope changes preserve the node if present. Otherwise show the original dated node and ask for a new selection. No nearest-node substitution.

ops.name: note-1
ops.html:
B02 / B10 · Phone controls
Views opens workspace destinations. Research opens range, breakdown, price context, compare, history/replay and source controls.
A menu uses modal focus containment, Esc/Close, and returns focus to its trigger. Changing view neither saves nor changes the selected observation.

ops.name: note-2
ops.html:
B03 · Exact contract handoff
A matrix cell may aggregate both rights. Inspect actual source members; choose the precise root, expiry, strike and right.
C validates accepted shortlist shapes, stale policy and terms. Missing multiplier/deliverable or ambiguous series cannot create an invented tradable instrument.

ops.name: note-3
ops.html:
B04 / B08 · Volatility
Expiry is a date identity, not a nearest-tenor guess. Missing selected expiry stays selected. Do not connect a line through an unavailable point.
IV/RV are percent numbers; adapter converts once if required. Published VRP remains verbatim. RR25 methods with opposite subtraction orders stay separate.

ops.name: note-4
ops.html:
B05 / B06 / B11 · Equal access
3D and exact 2D share the qualified projection and selection. Window, cap, mode, unit and full-lens normalization stay unchanged.
Gamma Surface is discrete. Phone exact rows are 48px; zero and missing are distinct. Every admitted row remains reachable after rendering limits or WebGL failure.

ops.name: note-5
ops.html:
B07 · Comparison basis
Compare only equal identity/scope/definition and advancing source sessions with both observations available at the cutoff.
Intersect finite actual contract members. Show set additions/deletions and qualification gained/lost separately. Net, gross and magnitude changes have different labels.

ops.name: note-6
ops.html:
B09 · Failure and access
Clear data immediately on root change. A refresh failure may keep only same-root authorized prior evidence with its original date.
Access unknown is not plan-required. Retry is explicit for reads. Durable save stays with the admitted owner and requires readback; unknown effects are not resubmitted.

ops.name: note-7
ops.html:
B13 / B14 · Strong incumbents
Research Lab mirrors side for separation; hollow marks encode negative ΔOI. Expiry depth is ordinal. Exact rows include zero/null and values beyond the draw cap.
Level labels may move to avoid collisions; price ticks never move. Null regime remains Unknown. Brightness is a source score, not a probability.
